description: An `http` header `{secret: api, prefix: "Bearer "}` is resolved at dispatch from `runtime.secrets.api` (an `env` secret here): the request carries `Bearer <value>`, `meta.params_rendered` shows `Bearer [secret:api]`, and the response, which echoes the value in its body and a header, has it replaced with `[secret:api]`. The value is a fake-credential marker, so the harness's own blanket check proves it reaches no --out, --events, --live-state, stdout or stderr. electricity resolves no secret yet and refuses the document with the preview marker.
